content: If parameter FrIf_ChnlIdx of FrIf_ClearTransceiverWakeup has an invalid value and if development error detection is enabled (i.e. FrIfDevErrorDetect equals ON), the function FrIf_ClearTransceiverWakeup shall report development error code FRIF_E_INV_CHNL_IDX to the Det_ReportError service of the DET module.
